title: FTP server restarts automatically after being turned off and leaving the FTP server screen

full_report.title: FTP server restarts automatically after being turned off and leaving the FTP server screen
full_report.observed_behavior: On the FTP server screen, if the user turns the server on, turns it off, leaves the FTP server screen, and then swipes the app away from Recents, the FTP server is restarting on its own.
full_report.expected_behavior: The FTP server should remain off after the user toggles it off and leaves the FTP server screen, and it should not restart automatically on its own.
full_report.steps_to_reproduce:
1. Open the app. <aa09f6aef3409759f67d672c9efcbd64d8f3b0ee61cf3e8d197f0539e34430d2>
2. On the permission dialog, tap Allow. <9253ef287211a96261d15d2522d1499f880b411f5e49851b98bae34f3403ab9d>
3. Open the navigation menu by tapping Navigate up. <3abd760d81519f7d0b2fe5daa74c918b40f9496bef2bf776dd7b0d8e95a47b49>
4. Select FTP server from the navigation drawer. <ed4ddd149d2da1bda9c6a957048313602988bce3f183bd199efeacece662aeec>
5. Tap the FTP server status switch while it is OFF to turn it ON. <5f369cd30bd1e5644d294c31e5ff58277cad40b2633f69cc4105944721df8b1b>
6. Tap the FTP server status switch while it is ON to turn it OFF. <8453ee6186ad267c55c0f443ad2d1644911453cf4f005a06837b415345db6be5>
7. Leave the FTP server screen by tapping Navigate up. <f5deb5a7a067fcecd183ba802aa26e2dfb3c5e38306d9407fd3b178866210afb>
8. Tap the list item to return to the FTP server screen path context. <6766d1c12b54808176b7d8e110b78ee25e2843492f806acedcc0d8e1da70972c>
9. Open Recents using the system Back/Recents control. <944abf1e97748f2436418aea5aa65a35e80ea307f807f0264ae85d2c80188e7c>
10. Dismiss the Files app task from Recents. <b05234dc13810ef197b494fe9ce3b3d6e6927d53c722ad904f3dc53e425da84c>

ground_truth.info_elements_gt:

Triggering GUI Interaction: stops the FTP server and then closes the app
Triggering Screen Reference: FTP server screen
Correct Behavior: The FTP server should remain stopped
